item.title: Pakistan team forced to spend night on streets; Faces major embarrassment
item.description: Pakistan’s national hockey team faced embarrassment in Canberra, Australia, after unpaid hotel bills forced players to wait on the streets ahead of the FIH Pro League matches. Managed later with limited rooms, the incident added pressure before a narrow loss to Australia.

item.title: Gold, Silver rebound on MCX amid 2026 volatility; Check price here
item.description: Gold and silver prices in India showed fresh strength on MCX after a volatile start to 2026, with both metals rebounding amid global uncertainty and shifting interest rate expectations.

item.title: Stock Market opens weak as AI concerns drag IT shares lower; Sensex tumbles 700 points
item.description: Indian stock markets opened sharply lower as Sensex plunged over 700 points and Nifty slipped below 25,600, dragged by persistent selling in IT stocks amid rising concerns over artificial intelligence disruption and weak global tech cues.

item.title: Budget Session phase one ends today; Lok Sabha to remember Bhagwan Dass Rathor
item.description: On the final day of the Budget Session’s first phase, the Lok Sabha will pay tribute to former MP Bhagwan Dass Rathor and take up questions, official papers, and committee reports. Ministers will present updates on mental health care, CGHS, and petroleum policies, while private members move key resolutions.

item.title: Who is Tariq Rahman? After 17 years in exile, poised to lead Bangladesh
item.description: Born on November 20, 1965, in Dhaka, Tariq Rahman is the eldest son of former President Ziaur Rahman and three-time Prime Minister Khaleda Zia. His father founded the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), one of the country’s two dominant political forces.

item.title: CM MK Stalin announces Rs 5,000 to woo 1.3 crore women ahead of TN polls
item.description: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister MK Stalin has announced ₹5,000 aid under the Kalainagar Women’s Rights Scheme, benefiting 1.31 crore women. The amount includes ₹3,000 monthly support and ₹2,000 summer bonus, transferred directly to bank accounts.

item.title: IND vs PAK: Will Abhishek Sharma miss match against Pakistan? Varun Chakravarthy reveals
item.description: Ahead of the high-voltage India vs Pakistan T20 World Cup 2026 clash on February 15, fans await Abhishek Sharma’s fitness update. After missing the Namibia match due to a stomach bug, Sharma has recovered, confirmed by Varun Chakravarthy.

item.title: Karnataka: Seven killed in multi-vehicle chain collision in Bengaluru
item.description: According to preliminary reports, the accident occurred when a speeding car hit a bike from behind. The severe impact caused the car to lose balance and collide head-on with a truck coming from the opposite direction.

item.title: Jharkhand Horror: Wild elephants trample six in Hazaribagh village
item.description: The tragic incident has sent shockwaves and panic in the entire area. According to villagers, a herd of five elephants entered the village between 1-2 AM while the entire was asleep asleep.

item.title: Ram Charan & Upasana reveal twin babies’ names; Meaning touches hearts
item.description: Ram Charan and Upasana Konidela recently revealed the names of their twin children - Shivram and Anveera Devi. Shivram symbolizes strength, dharma, and devotion, while Anveera Devi represents courage and divine feminine power.
